moments.label: Framework Overview
moments.why: Instructor displays the one-slide framework showing the three-step system with moving averages and price structure

moments.label: Step One Definition
moments.why: Instructor explains step one: meaningful break and close beyond 10 and 20 SMA

moments.label: Step Two Definition
moments.why: Instructor describes step two: visual return toward trend area and obvious consolidation

moments.label: Step Three Definition
moments.why: Instructor defines step three: break of pre-selected consolidation in direction of step one

moments.label: Step One Criteria
moments.why: Instructor details the requirement for a meaningful close above both 10 and 20 SMA

moments.label: Step Two Retest
moments.why: Instructor explains waiting for price to return toward 10 and 20 SMA trend area

moments.label: Base Selection
moments.why: Instructor discusses selecting a clear boundary for the base before break

moments.label: Resistance Boundary
moments.why: Instructor shows a horizontal dashed line marking resistance boundary on chart

moments.label: Boundary Selection
moments.why: Instructor explains selecting the most controlling boundary before break

moments.label: Step Three Break
moments.why: Instructor describes price breaking the pre-selected boundary in direction of step one

moments.label: Step Three Confirmation
moments.why: Instructor explains the need for a confirmed close beyond boundary to validate entry

moments.label: Gap Through Boundary
moments.why: Instructor discusses gap through boundary counting as break

moments.label: Close Determines Confirmation
moments.why: Instructor explains that close determines if step three confirms or fails

moments.label: Chart setup with SMA indicators
moments.why: Instructor shows the chart with 10 and 20 SMA lines, explaining their role in the three-step system.

moments.label: Bearish step three break
moments.why: Price breaks below the base, completing step three of a bearish sequence.

moments.label: Price extending from moving averages
moments.why: Price moves far away from the 10 SMA, indicating a climax and potential partial profit opportunity.

moments.label: Retest of base and moving averages
moments.why: Price retests the 50 SMA without closing below the 10 SMA, showing a continuation pattern.

moments.label: Bearish setup example
moments.why: Price creates a lower high and breaks below moving averages, forming a bearish sequence.

moments.label: Incomplete step three
moments.why: Price has steps one and two but fails to complete step three with a breakout.

moments.label: Higher timeframe trend direction
moments.why: Price is staying above the 200 SMA, indicating a bullish higher timeframe trend.

moments.label: Obvious consolidation for entry
moments.why: Price forms a clear consolidation after breaking above the moving averages, signaling an entry opportunity.

moments.label: Breakout confirmation
moments.why: Price closes above the consolidation boundary, confirming step three and entry.

moments.label: Gap up breakout
moments.why: Price gaps above resistance, confirming a bullish break and entry point.

moments.label: Second bullish sequence
moments.why: Price breaks above, retests, and continues higher, forming another valid setup.

moments.label: Break of trend line and retracement
moments.why: Price breaks a trend line with a larger retracement, completing the full framework.

moments.label: Three-step system summary
moments.why: Instructor recaps the full sequence: step one (break), step two (base formation), step three (entry break).

moments.label: Opposite step three as exit signal
moments.why: The opposite direction's step three serves as the final technical exit for the position.
